svg.aria-label: Terminal replaying llm-evalkit on methodology-rag's saved runs: accuracy 81.9% (77 of 94, 95% interval 73 to 88%), grounded accuracy 66.0%, unanswerable refused 100% (14 of 14); comparing two runs on 126 shared questions, 69.8% to 81.7%, exact McNemar p = 0.0026, a real difference at the 5% level.
